title: Kissed Resinous Syrian Tofu Pilaf
description: A comforting Syrian dish featuring crispy serrano ham and sashimi-cut tofu, made vegan-friendly by substituting ham with a plant-based alternative, all cooked to perfection in a wok.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into sashimi-style pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced plant-based serrano ham and cook until crispy, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the wok and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the wok and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the rinsed basmati rice to the wok, stirring to coat the rice in oil and mix with the onion and garlic.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the wok, stirring to combine.
Add 4 cups of water to the wok and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer the pilaf for 20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
While the pilaf cooks, toast the pine nuts in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Once the pilaf is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in the toasted pine nuts and crispy plant-based serrano ham.
Add the sashimi-cut tofu to the pilaf and stir gently to combine.
